**I haven’t proposed or changed the layout yet**—the sofa and table are still in their original positions. My last message offered three ways to approach “cozier.”

The rug-and-lamp option would visually bring the seating area together and add softer, local light. Rearranging would focus on grouping your existing pieces, while warmer wall colours would change the atmosphere without adding furniture.

My recommendation is to start with **a rug and lamp around your existing sofa**; exact products, placement and cost still need checking.
